entities.name: RRC Protocol
entities.description: Radio Resource Control protocol that manages connection establishment, mobility, security, and configuration between UE and network.

entities.name: System Information Broadcast
entities.description: Broadcasts system information including NAS common information and parameters for different RRC states.

entities.name: RRC_IDLE
entities.description: RRC state where UE is not connected but can receive broadcast information and perform cell selection.

entities.name: RRC_INACTIVE
entities.description: RRC state where UE maintains connection context but uses less power, can receive broadcast information.

entities.name: RRC_CONNECTED
entities.description: RRC state where UE has active connection with network for data transmission.

entities.name: AS Security Activation
entities.description: Initial configuration of Access Stratum integrity protection and ciphering for SRBs and DRBs.

entities.name: RRC Connection Mobility
entities.description: Handles intra-frequency and inter-frequency handover with associated AS security handling and RRC context transfer.

entities.name: Radio Bearer Management
entities.description: Establishment, modification, suspension, resumption and release of SRBs and DRBs/MRBs.

entities.name: Measurement Configuration
entities.description: Establishment, modification and release of measurement configuration including intra-frequency, inter-frequency and inter-RAT measurements.

entities.name: Inter-RAT Mobility
entities.description: Mobility between different radio access technologies with AS security activation and RRC context transfer.

relations.description: RRC protocol includes system information broadcast as one of its main functions.
System information broadcast provides information applicable for UEs in RRC_IDLE state.
System information broadcast provides information applicable for UEs in RRC_INACTIVE state.
System information broadcast provides information applicable for UEs in RRC_CONNECTED state.
